in_sanskrit.name: Karbhari
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Strong, Powerful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Karbhari एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Karbhari is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Karpa' meaning 'strong' and 'Bhari' meaning 'bearer'. This name is often given to boys who are believed to possess great strength and the ability to bear heavy responsibilities.
